title: 2.8 Colors
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with their articles, count them, and say their color and size.
goal: Name six colors and say what color something is: Das ist rot. Der Bus ist rot.
grammar_function: Welche Farbe hat das? Das ist + color; der/die/das + noun + ist + color.
